title: Unlink a TikTok account from a Business Center
content_data:
Use this endpoint to unlink a TikTok account from a Business Center. Once a TikTok account is unlinked from a Business Center, all active ads that are using this TikTok account may be paused, and the account may lose access to [Business Suite](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/navigate-web-business-suite). ## Before you start Ensure you are an Admin of the Business Center. To confirm your permission to a Business Center, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and check whether the returned `user_role` is `ADMIN`. ### Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset/tt_account/unlink/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{35%}|Type{15%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/marketing-api-authentication/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed value: `application/json`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{35%}|Type{15%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |bc_id {Required}|string|Business Center ID.

To obtain the list of Business Centers that you can access, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3).| |asset_ids {Required}|string[]|A list of asset IDs of the TikTok accounts to unlink.

To obtain the asset IDs of TikTok accounts linked to a Business Center, use [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-assets/v1.3) and set `asset_type` to `TT_ACCOUNT`.

Max size: 1.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset/tt_account/unlink/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "bc_id": "{{bc_id}}", "asset_ids": [ "{{asset_id}}" ] }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
